lanes.summary: The diff correctly addresses the two open, non-blocking items from round 3. First, it updates the `readers.worlds` list in `contracts/ontology.yaml` and the metadata references in `contracts/ont-valid-under-v1.yaml` to include `lint/valid_under_gate.rs`.
